officialTitle: Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy versus chemotherapy in untreated advanced pleural mesothelioma in Canada, Italy, and France: a phase 3, open-label, randomised controlled trial

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: Between Jan 31, 2017, and Sept 4, 2020, 440 patients were enrolled and randomly assigned to chemotherapy alone (n=218) or chemotherapy with pembrolizumab (n=222).
design.notes: 51 hospitals in Canada, Italy and France; ECOG PS 0-1. Final analysis reported.

sponsor: Canadian Cancer Society and Merck & Co
clinicalQuestion: Does adding pembrolizumab to platinum-pemetrexed improve overall survival in untreated advanced pleural mesothelioma?

pico.population: Previously untreated advanced pleural mesothelioma, ECOG PS 0-1
pico.intervention: Platinum-pemetrexed plus pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks (up to 2 years)

arms.label: Pembrolizumab + chemotherapy
arms.dosing: Cisplatin 75 mg/m2 or carboplatin AUC 5-6 with pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 every 3 weeks for up to 6 cycles, plus pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks up to 2 years
arms.doseSourceQuote: Patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to intravenous chemotherapy (cisplatin [75 mg/m] or carboplatin [area under the concentration-time curve 5-6 mg/mL per min] with pemetrexed 500 mg/m, every 3 weeks for up to 6 cycles), with or without intravenous pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks (up to 2 years).

publications.title: Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy versus chemotherapy in untreated advanced pleural mesothelioma in Canada, Italy, and France: a phase 3, open-label, randomised controlled trial.
publications.label: Final analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: At final analysis (database lock Dec 15, 2022), with a median follow-up of 16·2 months (IQR 8·3-27·8), overall survival was significantly longer with pembrolizumab (median overall survival 17·3 months [95% CI 14·4-21·3] with pembrolizumab vs 16·1 months [13·1-18·2] with chemotherapy alone, hazard ratio for death 0·79; 95% CI 0·64-0·98, two-sided p=0·0324). 3-year overall survival rate was 25% (95% CI 20-33%) with pembrolizumab and 17% (13-24%) with chemotherapy alone.

safety.sourceQuote: Adverse events related to study treatment of grade 3 or 4 occurred in 60 (27%) of 222 patients in the pembrolizumab group and 32 (15%) of 211 patients in the chemotherapy alone group.
Grade 5 adverse events related to one or more drugs occurred in two patients on the pembrolizumab group and one patient in the chemotherapy alone group.

strengths: Randomised phase III trial with OS primary endpoint
International academic cooperative-group trial allowing cisplatin or carboplatin
limitations: Modest absolute difference in median OS
More grade 3-4 treatment-related toxicity with pembrolizumab

clinicalImplications.text: Adding pembrolizumab to platinum-pemetrexed significantly prolonged overall survival in untreated advanced pleural mesothelioma, providing a chemo-immunotherapy alternative to dual checkpoint blockade.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Chemo-immunotherapy and nivolumab-ipilimumab are both first-line options; histology and the need for a rapid response may inform the choice, though they have not been compared directly.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 37931632. The acronym IND.227 is not printed in the abstract; it follows common usage and should be confirmed on review.
